dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Courage is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Courage has been observed to be highly rope reactive and mouthy. Noted to jump up and bite the leash, mouth handlers, and nip at their clothing. Courage has been observed to jump up, bite, and tug on the leash. This behavior is difficult to redirect. While on leash, Courage has been observed to nip handlers pants legs several times and mouth their hands. With handlers, Courage has been observed to have a loose and wiggly body and accept contact. Medically, Courage has CIRDC and is underweight.

Courage arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, he has been observed to be highly rope reactive and mouthy. Noted to jump up and bite the leash, mouth handlers, and nip at their clothing. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Courage
